01 Does the address start with https and you typed it — or did it come from SMS / a chat? I typed it. https. The bank name I already use. I tapped a link. The padlock is there, the name almost matches. http, a certificate warning, or a look-alike name (banc0, .xyz).

02 Password and card: on which screen? Only on the institution’s site or app. Never in a chat. The app. I once pasted a code that arrived by SMS. A form in the chat, a stranger’s QR, ‘update your file’.
03 A certificate warning or a ‘not secure’ page? I leave. I do not proceed. I do not ‘accept the risk’. I have already proceeded ‘just this once’. I always proceed. I want to get there.
04 From where do you open the bank? Cellular data or the house Wi-Fi. Not the café’s open net. Street Wi-Fi, but with the house VPN (paid, named). An open net, no question.
